name: Africa Gardens
summary: Africa Gardens is a classic text adventure that immerses you in the eerie atmosphere of an old Victorian hotel. What begins as a polite welcome message soon turns sinister – guests have vanished without a trace, and no one ever seems to leave. As you explore the hotel's corridors, salons, and shadowy rooms, you'll gather useful items, solve puzzles, and uncover the chilling secret behind Africa Gardens. But beware: you can only carry a few items at once, and every wrong choice may lead to a dead end.
